summary:
An astronaut had just completed a mission to the Moon and Mars when her rocket suddenly informed her that she had another mission: to find a broken rover.
​She arrived on the Moon first to search for the rover, but she only found an old camera left behind by a previous astronaut. Inside the camera were many pictures of the historical figure Neil Armstrong, the first person to land on the Moon. Interestingly, he earned his pilot's license at age 16 before he even got his driver's license.
​After looking through all the pictures, the astronaut realized she needed to focus on her mission. She flew near Mars and noticed the broken rover floating around, being attacked by aliens. The astronaut got out of her ship to help because rovers are important. they help people discover more parts of Mars. She almost lost the fight against the aliens, but she kept going. As the sun rose, she managed to defeat them.
​She took the rover to the ISS to fix it, and after repairing it, she returned it to its mission. Then, she went back to Earth as a hero.
details:
Space exploration has left behind spacecraft and scientific equipment on the Moon and Mars. Although these objects are no longer being used, they still hold important stories and scientific value.

Through our project, THE C’S LEGACY, we aim to bring these forgotten objects back into the spotlight. We created an interactive digital museum and a storytelling video to introduce these objects, explain their purposes and highlight their importance to space exploration.

We also share ways to reduce space waste through better mission planning, reusing equipment and managing discarded materials responsibly.

Our goal is to make learning about space history more interesting while encouraging responsible space exploration.

Every forgotten object has a story!
